sports.static_subtitle: Here are a few quick suggestions to train in Pilates, Yoga, cycling or Cardio HIIT.

Yoga.title: The 5 pillars of yoga
items: The path to well-being: harmonize body and mind every day.
Asanas: suitable physical exercises to strengthen and loosen the body.
Pranayama: proper breathing to better manage energy and stress.
Savasana: deep relaxation to recover and release tension.
Vedanta & Dhyana: positive thoughts and meditation to calm the mind.
Healthy eating: eat better to live better and support your practice.

Cardio.title: Benefits of cardiovascular training
items: Improves heart health and reduces the risk of cardiovascular disease.
Helps maintain a healthy weight by burning many calories.
Boosts cognitive skills (attention, memory, problem solving).
Reduces anxiety and depression and improves overall mood.
Improves sleep quality and daytime energy levels.
Supports seniors' autonomy by strengthening balance and endurance.

HIIT.title: Benefits of HIIT
items: Lets you train in little time with results comparable to longer sessions.
Burns many calories during the session and afterward thanks to the afterburn effect.
Can be done almost anywhere, often without specific equipment.
Greatly improves VO2 max and cardiovascular capacity.
Helps regulate blood sugar and improve insulin sensitivity.
Can reduce blood pressure and resting heart rate.

Musculation.title: Strength training benefits
items: Increases strength and muscle mass for daily activities.
Strengthens bones and helps prevent osteoporosis.
Improves posture and protects the joints.
Speeds up resting metabolism, making weight control easier.
Helps regulate blood sugar and blood lipids.
Boosts self-confidence and body image.

Étirements.title: Why stretch?
items: Improve flexibility and range of motion.
Reduce muscle tension and certain pains.
Prepare muscles for effort and lower the risk of injury.
Promote recovery after training.
Aid relaxation and stress management.

Pilates.title: Benefits of Pilates
items: Strengthens deep muscles, especially the core.
Improves posture and body alignment.
Develops stability, balance and control of movements.
Can reduce and prevent lower back pain.
Works on breathing and body awareness.
Adapts to many fitness levels.

Danse Fitness.title: Why choose Dance Fitness?
items: Offers a playful, rhythmic cardio workout.
Improves coordination, sense of rhythm and balance.
Helps burn calories while having fun.
Stimulates self-expression and confidence.
Reduces stress and improves mood thanks to music.

Marche Active.title: Benefits of power walking
items: Gentle activity accessible to almost everyone.
Improves heart health and blood circulation.
Helps control weight when practiced regularly.
Strengthens muscles of the legs, hips and core.
Easily fits into the daily routine (commutes, leisure).
Supports mental health by reducing stress and clearing the mind.
